description: This team is looking for members who are creative and completely in love with planets and their amazing information.
summary:
This project focuses on the Solar System and knowing about it by the development of the creation of an interactive video game. This game faces real-world scientific problems that astronauts and engineers must consider while planning a mission, such as how our decisions about materials when creating a ship (weight and radiation) and the energy that will be used in planning the journey can affect the traveller's ability to reach his or her goals.
In the game, we have the Solar System map, and the gamer needs to choose destinations like Venus, Mercury, Uranus, etc. The decisions should have real consequences that will affect the story of the game. 
The final objective of this project is to create an immersive experience that combines video games, space simulation and scientific outreach, that let the player to learn about the Solar System while experiments the emotion and the challenges of becoming a real space explorer.
details:
This project is an educational video game for kids and people who want to learn about the Solar System and how decisions about materials when people create their spaceship can affect missions.

In the video game, users should build their explorer with a main structure, heat shield, radiation protection, propulsion system, and a cargo module and search for the best option. In the missions, users will have to decide on a situation, such as a life support failure, and on each planet or moon, they must answer a question about the selected planet.
Its benefits are that users can learn about the Solar System and learn about current problems in a fun way.

This project intends to impact people of all ages, but especially students from schools around the world.
